title: Travis Etienne's arrival could close the door on Alvin Kamara in New Orleans

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Travis Etienne's arrival could close the door on Alvin Kamara in New Orleans
sources.description: With the Saints adding running back Travis Etienne on a reported four-year, $52 million deal, Alvin Kamara's nine-year run with the team could be ending.
